shaders_estimated_depth_desc: Roblox does not share its depth buffer, so ReShade effects that need it (SSR, MXAO, depth of field, fog...) get a depth estimated from the image.
shaders_needs_depth_tip: This effect reads the depth buffer, which Roblox does not share with other programs. Depth-based parts (fog, depth of field, SSAO, SSR...) will not work and may look wrong.
shaders_performance_desc: Lighter effects for weaker PCs (less lag). Turns on by itself on integrated graphics.
shaders_uses_estimated_depth_tip: This effect reads the depth buffer. Roblox does not share it, so it gets a depth estimated from the image (ground, horizon and where objects touch the ground). It works well on open floors; very complex scenes are less accurate.
